description: API specification for managing and retrieving the status and configuration of the OpenVPN Client service, including response schemas, request bodies, and event notifications.

classes.name: Services.Local.VPN.OpenVPN.Client
classes.description: Object representing the OpenVPN Client configuration and status, including properties for status, interfaces, remote server info, statistics, and operational events.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.OpenVPN.Client.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and configuration parameters of the OpenVPN Client, including detailed response schemas and possible error codes.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.OpenVPN.Client.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistics counters for the OpenVPN Client, with response schemas and possible error codes.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.OpenVPN.Client.Set
methods.description: Modifies the status and configuration of the OpenVPN Client, including properties for enabling/disabling, remote configuration, interface selection, and statistics, along with event notifications.
